name: dragonwood
lore_descriptor: scaled bark, warm to the touch, smelling of smoke
first_pickup_chronicle: Dragonwood, from trees that drank dragon breath. I held it in a torch flame to test it. The fire passed straight through like it was visiting.
design_notes: Chain combat v2 tuning: damage_mult 1.30, weight_mult 1.00, effective_against dragon (T4 specialty wood, kin-strike). Mid-late tier for staff/bow.
